title: crypto2dev_cdev.c: /dev/crypto2dev misc_register, ioctl dispatch
description:
Implement /dev/wolfcrypt file_operations in wolfkm_cdev.c.

Each fd is an independent session. Streaming write()/read() model.

file_operations to implement:
- .open: kzalloc wolfkm_fd_state, attach to file->private_data
- .release: call wolfkm_fd_destroy() — memzero_explicit + kfree
- .write: if !state->initialized return -ENODEV; wolfkm_fips_gate() first; copy_from_user; feed wolfCrypt streaming update; buffer output; increment bytes_written
- .read: flush buffered output to userspace; for hashes, finalize on first read(); for AEAD decrypt, verify tag before returning plaintext (-EBADMSG on failure); increment bytes_read
- .unlocked_ioctl: dispatch all ioctls; wolfkm_fips_gate() at top of every handler EXCEPT STATUS and GET_STATE (those do not invoke wolfCrypt); validate all input sizes; check all copy_from_user returns
  - INIT: configure algo/key/op; reject if already initialized
  - SET_IV / SET_AAD / GET_TAG / SET_TAG: forward to wolfkm_fd.c
  - STATUS: copy module-level stats (no wolfCrypt call)
  - GET_STATE: copy algo, op, initialized, bytes_written, bytes_read from fd state (no wolfCrypt call)
- .compat_ioctl: 32-bit userspace on 64-bit kernel

Register as misc device: name='wolfcrypt', minor=MISC_DYNAMIC_MINOR.

Exported: wolfkm_cdev_init(), wolfkm_cdev_exit().
design: CRYPT handler flow: copy wolfkm_crypt_op from user; look up session; validate op.len <= WOLFKM_CRYPT_MAX_BYTES; copy src from user (kmalloc, kfree on exit); call wolfCrypt; copy dst/mac to user. Use goto for cleanup on error paths. STATUS handler reads wolfCrypt_GetStatus_fips(), session count from IDR, and MODULE_VERSION. .compat_ioctl: use compat_ptr() on all __user pointer fields in wolfkm_crypt_op. See DESIGN.md §file_operations.
acceptance_criteria: /dev/wolfcrypt appears after insmod. AES-CBC encrypt+decrypt roundtrip via ioctl returns correct plaintext. STATUS ioctl returns correct fips_state. Bad algorithm ID returns -EINVAL. Input > 1MB returns -EMSGSIZE.
close_reason: Already implemented: src/cdev/crypto2dev_cdev.c exists with misc_register, ioctl dispatch, and full file_operations.
